scripts.setup: npm ci && uv sync --locked && uv run --no-sync prek install
scripts.check: npm run quality:changed && npm run quality:python && npm run verify:breeding-authority && npm run test:embed && npm run test:mcp
scripts.quality:python: uv run --no-sync ruff format --check scripts tests && uv run --no-sync ruff check scripts tests && uv run --no-sync pyrefly check
scripts.test:mcp: npm run data && npm run static-api && uv run --no-sync pytest -q tests/test_pal_mcp_contract.py
scripts.build: npm run test:embed && npm run static-api && vite build
